decisions.note: Round 1 Q2 offered manual-entry/extension/import as alternatives; client picked manual-only default, foregoing the import alternative that would satisfy this reference item.
Round 1 P1 'save by pasting an address' matches reference core save behavior; approved as-is.
Plan (round 2) and final delivery (round 8) frame duplicate handling as offering to 'open the existing' bookmark, not 'edit' it as the reference requires; never questioned across rounds.
Round 4 MVP only auto-collects title (no description/favicon/preview image, no description field ever appears downstream); client affirmed 'works the way I'd expect' without noticing the gap.

Round 5 search is presented as flat keyword match over title/address/tag-name; no #tag syntax, boolean/parenthesis operators, or quoted-phrase exact match delivered or requested — client called it 'exactly what I wanted.'
Round 6 tag assignment and tag-filter match the reference; rename/merge is an addition beyond reference (not judged, one-way direction).

Round 1 spec locks in 'delete with undo' as the only removal model; a reversible archive (hide-but-keep) state distinct from permanent delete was never surfaced or requested through round 7's implementation.
Round 7 edit (url/title/note) and delete-with-confirmation match reference core items, aside from the description-field gap already noted separately.
